Question: Does capability shift conflict composition toward minor/extraterritorial conflict?
Method: Two-way FE panel regression, 3 MTS specs × 6 outcomes, 1989–2024
Headline Result: 1/5 directional predictions supported, 1/5 opposed (wrong sign, significant), 3/5 null. Battle-death intensity is significantly positive (β=2.03, p=0.0006).

Question: Do weapon-class acquisitions precede increases in low-intensity conflict?
Method: Cross-correlation + Dumitrescu-Hurlin panel Granger + placebo falsification
Headline Result: 0/36 (weapon, outcome, lag) cells survive placebo falsification. AIR class — central to the Drone Effect hypothesis — shows no significant result at any lag.

Question: Do countries cluster into distinct, stable conflict-capability archetypes?
Headline Result: k=4 archetypes identified (silhouette + gap statistic). 0/4 bootstrap-stable (Jaccard > 0.75). Out-of-sample ANOVA significant: F=33.6, p=0.0000.
